preferences: I like to start my days slowly, ideally with meditation or a quiet walk. I despise rushing from landmark to landmark. I prefer spending 3 hours soaking in the atmosphere of one temple rather than seeing five temples in one day. I eat a vegetarian diet and prefer cafes with river or mountain views.

I want to maximize my time. I wake up early to beat the crowds at major historical sites and museums. I don't mind walking 15,000 steps a day. I want efficient transit routes and quick lunches near the landmarks so I don't waste time traveling back and forth across the city.

I plan my trips entirely around my meals. I want to visit local spice markets in the morning, find the best hidden street food stalls for lunch, and have reservations at highly-rated atmospheric restaurants for dinner. I prefer lively, bustling neighborhoods.
